holisticReview.assessment: A coherent short recovery mission with useful feedback and accessible assistance, plus demonstrable short-batch manual combat. Stronger usability than precision readability. Route-assisted completion and two wins do not establish sustained unassisted combat comfort or enjoyment. Memory content, KIT tools, AIM zoom, jump, settings options and audio were not assessed. No visible settings were changed.

scoreScale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed but playable, 7 good with meaningful friction, 9 excellent with minor friction, 10 exceptional across assessed scope. Subjective holistic emulated-mobile scores, not derived from win/loss or terminal score; no physical-device certification.

scoreReasons.controls: Simultaneous MOVE/FIRE drag, scene turn and DASH responded visibly. Target taps and assistance help; pillar occlusion and interrupted holds limit confidence in continuous combat.
scoreReasons.gameplay: Recoveries, relay armor/optic and coil stages provide understandable progression and corrections. Heavy assisted traversal and short paused runs leave depth, sustained challenge and continuous enjoyment unassessed.
scoreReasons.presentation: Cohesive rain, wet surfaces and cyan/gold visual language; attractive title and clean result screen in emulation. Audio and hardware smoothness unassessed.
scoreReasons.usability: Contextual HOLD action, visible mission checks, map and explicit assistance stats helped progress. Repeated turn cues and off-screen damage impose orientation work.
scoreReasons.readability: Core health/ammo/objective legible; optic/coil labels and small distant threats are harder at landscape mobile size, with translucent control overlays competing with scene.
